d: An adolescent with a curvy build, featuring rose-pink hair of medium length with voluminous waves and blunt-cut bangs. The eyes are a bright cyan blue with a cheerful expression, set on a youthful face. The outfit is a sleeveless white utility dress with a high collar, breast pockets, and a red belt at the waist, complemented by a red scarf tied around the neck.
